title: A ring buffer: write at tail, read at head, both wrap around
caption: Capacity 3. When head == tail the buffer is either empty or full; count tells which.

frames.text: Empty: head = tail = 0 and count = 0. A consumer calling take() would wait on not_empty.
Producers put a and b: each write lands at tail, then tail moves one slot on.
put c fills the last slot and tail wraps to 0. head == tail again, but count = 3 says full: the next put() waits on not_full.
A consumer takes a from head, frees the slot and moves head to 1. count = 2, so a waiting producer is woken.
put d reuses slot 0 (tail wrapped), and tail moves to 1. The buffer is full again with no copying.
